title: feat: cap card width at ~960px and center the main list
description: Cards span the full viewport at 1280/1440/1920px, leaving large empty space between the title and chips on the right, and producing 130+ char description lines that are hard to read. Suggested fix: main { max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; } (and maybe a higher max-width for true desktop). Cards stay full-width within that container. See tmp/responsive/{1280,1440,1920}.png.
